exam_scheme.note: The Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM) is conducted on a rotational basis by the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) for admissions to M.Sc., M.Sc.-Ph.D. Dual Degree, and other postgraduate degree programmes across 21 IITs and IISc Bangalore, as well as NITs and CFTIs via CCMN. JAM is a 3-hour Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 60 questions carrying a total of 100 marks across 7 test papers: Biotechnology (BT), Chemistry (CY), Economics (EN), Geology (GG), Mathematics (MA), Mathematical Statistics (MS), and Physics (PH). The question paper is divided into three sections: Section A (30 MCQs: 10 of 1 mark each and 20 of 2 marks each, negative marking 1/3 and 2/3), Section B (10 Multiple Select Questions MSQs of 2 marks each, no negative marking), and Section C (20 Numerical Answer Type NATs: 10 of 1 mark each and 10 of 2 marks each, no negative marking).
